reason: Non-streamed OpenAI-compatible complete() (every chat routing step on OpenRouter, local runtimes and gateways, the mission specialists that share the adapter, compaction, naming) used the 120 s client default as the read timeout for the whole generation, while #486 gave only the native adapters the 600 s read / 10 s connect request_timeout_seconds option; with #488 resending a timed-out generation and #492 raising the default output to 32,000 tokens, a thinking model's legitimate long answer was paid for three times and still failed. complete() now uses the same helper (option, NEBULA_PROVIDER_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, explicit timeout_seconds kept); streams and catalog/health calls keep their short timeouts. The capability probe sent max_output_tokens=128 with no reasoning control, so thinking models (Fable 5.1, Opus 5, DeepSeek/GLM on OpenRouter) spent the budget before their one call and verification failed, leaving tools disabled; naming, retrieval planning, compaction and scope import likewise never switched thinking off (audit MODEL-2). The probe now allows 2,048 tokens bounded by the model's known or configured output limit and served window, waits 120 s instead of 30, and asks reasoning_effort=none; the four utility requests ask none too, and the OpenAI-compatible adapter resends once without the disable when a route answers 400 naming reasoning or thinking (mandatory-reasoning models, OpenAI families with no none level). tests/v3/test_inference_timeouts_probe_budget.py covers each change (19 of 21 fail on main; two guards pin that streams, discovery, unrelated 400s and operator-chosen levels are unchanged). The selected existing node ids directly drive the probe, the native request-timeout helper, OpenAI-compatible complete() retries, the compaction and scope-import requests, and chat retrieval planning and naming.
exclusions: Scoped per the CI-scoping rule: whole existing files are not listed; test_providers.py, test_provider_verification.py, test_native_adapter_requests.py, test_native_adapter_outcomes.py, test_openai_compatible_robustness.py, test_openai_compatible_parameters.py, test_reasoning_recovery.py, test_context.py, test_scope_import.py, test_specialist_routing_tolerance.py, test_specialist_tool_batches.py, test_orchestration.py, test_model_output_budget.py, test_chat.py, test_missions.py, test_project_instructions.py and the provider/probe tests in test_api.py were run locally (all pass) and are reported in the PR body. No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: the area:core-api real-Core journeys run against a stub provider and never observe a provider request's timeout, the probe budget or reasoning controls; the Python tests drive the adapter wire payloads, the probe and each utility request directly. No full suites.
